summary: uniQure N.V. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement with Leerink Partners for an upsized public offering of 4,945,055 ordinary shares at $45.50 per share, plus full exercise of the overallotment option for 741,758 additional shares, raising net proceeds of approximately $242.7 million. The offering was conducted via a shelf registration statement. The closing is expected on June 25, 2026. This is a routine equity capital raise (a shelf takedown), not a special situation. No activist, merger, or restructuring elements are present. What to watch: dilution impact on existing shareholders.
